title: Blood Donation System
subtitle: Role-Based Full Stack Platform
description: A full-stack blood donation management system with role-based authentication for Admin, User, and Volunteer — secured with JWT.
problemSolved: Finding blood donors urgently is a major challenge in Bangladesh. This platform connects donors with recipients in real time, while the role-based system ensures admins can manage requests, volunteers can coordinate drives, and users can find donors instantly — all in one place.

title: Paw Mart
subtitle: Full Stack Pet Care Platform
description: A comprehensive pet care e-commerce platform where users can browse, purchase pet products and book veterinary services.
problemSolved: Pet owners in Bangladesh struggled to find a single platform for both pet products and vet services. Paw Mart solves this by combining an e-commerce store with a service booking system — saving time and providing a seamless experience for pet lovers.

title: Hero-IO
subtitle: App Management Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard simulating a mobile OS application manager, featuring real-time UI updates and continuous data backup using browser LocalStorage.
problemSolved: Simulating persistent app installation without a backend is tricky. Hero-IO handles this by using LocalStorage to save user actions, ensuring installed apps stay intact after a page refresh and vanish immediately upon uninstallation.
